msg.held.dash.after: Unconvincing. Make your dash the last hit.
msg.held.dash.why: review: T14/T15: 'Try harder.' now opens three lines (msg.held, held.dash, held.cone); keep it for Lawrence's cone line and the fallback.

msg.held.drop.after: Gravity unused. Drop onto a car from above.
msg.held.drop.why: review: Sense: 'Wrong angle' sends the trainee after an angle when the brief wants a drop from above, and 'Wrong' already opens three other put-downs.

msg.held.jump.after: Grounded effort. Jump into a car to finish.

msg.held.level.after: Too low. Take the last hit on a raised road.

msg.held.cone.after: Try harder. Bait a car with a cone, then get hit by it.
msg.held.cone.why: review: Canon (row 620): without the cone the fix reads as body-baiting, which makes a car divert but does not count; the cone and the same car must both be named.

msg.held.push.after: Out of order. Push off a car; take the next one.
msg.held.push.why: T15: per brief; push, then the next car

msg.held.bounce.after: Too steady. Take the last hit while thrown.

msg.held.struck.after: Overeager. Do not dash; let a car come to you.
msg.held.struck.why: review: Mechanic: the brief allows walking or standing and fails only a dash, so 'Stand still' misstates it; also the third 'Too ...' put-down beside held.level and held.bounce.

msg.held.combo.after: Short chain. Make the last hit link {n} or later.
msg.held.combo.why: T15: per brief; keeps the link number

msg.held.cls.after: Wrong vehicle. Only a {cls} may finish you.
msg.held.cls.why: T15: per brief; keeps the class

bark.b017.after: My route was set, and we met anyway. Rude.
bark.b017.why: review: R2: bait is true for any locked, expiring or interrupted route (cone, return, yield), so 'I routed around it' and 'It rerouted into me' claim a dodge and a move the trigger does not log.

bark.b068.after: Not today. Please keep practising elsewhere.
bark.b068.why: review: T11: the rewrite still opens on 'Missed me', as b051 and b060 do, so the stock opener the writer meant to cut remains in three miss lines.

story.tale.monument.B3.after: Two screens advertise to each other, not to you. Legs 1 is fitted: jump into the traffic between them.
story.tale.monument.B3.why: review: V11: dropping 'between them' cuts the jump loose from the LED canyon, and 'neither advertises you yet' promises publicity the canon never gives the trainee.

story.ending.after: Your model has passed and will be manufactured for our clients. A Corporation drone carries you to the ship.
story.ending.why: kept (review): T1/T4/V6: 'adequately' turns the CERTIFIED payoff into a wink; T16 withholds praise on status lines, not on the ending that honours the sacrifice.

rep.task.after: Off brief: not counted, but {points} points kept. Next body's last hit: {brief}.
rep.task.why: review: Sense: '{points} points, not counted' reads as if the points were voided, when only the tile count is lost; also a fourth 'Wrong ...' put-down.

copy.denied.drop.after: No legal room. Down on the street, face open ground.
copy.denied.drop.why: review: Mechanic: a cone goes down only at street height (onGround), so 'Face open ground' misleads a trainee on a highway or roof.

copy.denied.throw.after: No room. Down on the street, face open road; throw (Y).
copy.denied.throw.why: review: Mechanic: a throw is refused anywhere above the street (onGround), so 'Face open road' misleads a trainee standing on a raised road.

place.levels.z1.after: Low highway: its own cars only. Broken parapets drop you.
place.levels.z1.why: review: Sense: 'own cars only' reads as a parking sign with no owner; the fact is that the highway keeps its own traffic.

pause.story.after: The story map saves this tile's count. The current chassis is lost.
pause.story.why: review: Canon: 'in service' is the word for the Certified's sacrifice to clients, so here it says the wrong thing about a chassis abandoned mid-tile.

ui.09.why: review: V1: 'GAMES' is banned in in-game text.

ui.16.why: review: V1: 'score' is banned in in-game text.

ui.18.why: review: V1: 'level' is banned; this pause row appears only in Arcade, where it restarts the district.
